RiskEngine_v1_superseded.sourceCommitNote: src/RiskEngine.sol was unchanged between b48efd4 and deployment, verified with git diff, so that hash describes the deployed bytecode.

allowlist.deliberatelyExcluded: The five faucet-supplied tokenized equities (TSLA, AMD, AMZN, NFLX, PLTR). Verified and recorded as INTEGRATIONS I13 but not allowlisted. See DECISIONS D13.

RiskEngine_v1_superseded.supersededReason: Allowlist extended to include Paxos USDG (0x7E955252E15c84f5768B83c41a71F9eba181802F), a real in-tier stablecoin verified against Paxos's published testnet deployments. The RiskEngine allowlist is fixed at construction with no setter, so extending it requires deploying a replacement engine. That is the intended mechanism, not a workaround - see DECISIONS.md D13.
RiskEngine_v1_superseded.recordKeptDeliberately: Kept rather than deleted. A superseded deployment that is documented is part of the honest record; silently removing it would leave a verified contract on chain with no explanation of why it exists or why it is not the current one.

RiskEngine.constructorArgsProvenance: Derived from the script source and cross-checked against the deployment transaction's input data, which ends with exactly this encoding - not taken from memory.

allowlist.deliberatelyExcluded: The five faucet-supplied tokenized equities (TSLA, AMD, AMZN, NFLX, PLTR) - INTEGRATIONS I13, DECISIONS D13. Also every impostor USDG - SECURITY-ANALYSIS S1.
allowlist.verifiedOnChain: Read back with cast after deployment: isApprovedAsset true for AVTA, AVTB and USDG; false for GenesisAgent (control), for TSLA, and for the impostor 'Paxos USDG' at 0x293b337712D4312776a3a2D292F44410E7873bAd. approvedAssetCount()==3, registry()==0x0D0080582D317D2878A31b01D97614a3E918dC65, MAX_DATA_AGE()==300.
allowlist.mixedDecimals: USDG is 6-decimal while AVTA/AVTB are 18-decimal. RiskEngine never reads decimals(); sizeUnits is a normalised 18-decimal simulated unit. See DECISIONS.md D14.

notDeployed.ArchetypeLib: internal-only library, inlined by the compiler; no linking required
notDeployed.MandateLib: internal-only library, inlined by the compiler; no linking required

smokeTest.verifiedIndependently: end state read back from the deployed contracts with cast call, not taken from the script's own logs; all five receipts confirmed status=true
smokeTest.note: Steps 2, 4 and 6 are reads and cost no gas, which is why eight steps produced five transactions.
smokeTest.runnableOnce: GenesisAgent allows one mint per address ever, so re-running this script from the same deployer reverts AlreadyMinted. That is the contract working.

notes: PROTOTYPE deployment. Not audited. Simulated capital only; balances have no redeemable value.
Neither contract has an owner, admin, or role-gated function.
Nothing is deployed to Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663), and the deploy script refuses it.

riskEngineDeployment.estimateNote: Actual cost was ~38% of the estimate because the estimate used the 0.02 gwei max fee while the chain settled at the 0.01 gwei base fee.

liveDemo.status: dry run clean against the live deployment; broadcast pending
liveDemo.transactionsRequired: at most 2 - an unpause only if automation is already paused, plus the beat-6 pause. Every other beat is a view and costs nothing.
